# @solana-programs/quarry

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@solana-programs/quarry.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@solana-programs/quarry)

TypeScript client for Quarry protocol programs

<!-- Generated by `bun run codegen` from programs/bundles.ts. Do not edit. -->

## Installation

```bash
bun add @solana-programs/quarry @solana/kit
```

## Included programs

This package contains no code of its own: it re-exports everything from the following packages, which can also be installed individually:

- `quarryMine`: [`@solana-programs/quarry-mine`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@solana-programs/quarry-mine)
- `quarryMergeMine`: [`@solana-programs/quarry-merge-mine`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@solana-programs/quarry-merge-mine)
- `quarryMintWrapper`: [`@solana-programs/quarry-mint-wrapper`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@solana-programs/quarry-mint-wrapper)
- `quarryOperator`: [`@solana-programs/quarry-operator`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@solana-programs/quarry-operator)
- `quarryRedeemer`: [`@solana-programs/quarry-redeemer`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@solana-programs/quarry-redeemer)
- `quarryRegistry`: [`@solana-programs/quarry-registry`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@solana-programs/quarry-registry)
